purpose: Make the already-evidenced SAT1 DXF carrier recovery reproducible for future independent ACIS reader checks.

implementation.scope: Exact-handle extraction for one ASCII DXF 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY, SAT v1 group-1/group-3 joining, inverse SAT1 byte transform, caret escape reversal, minimal SAT header/end-marker validation, and safe output overwrite refusal. Research aid only.

algorithmEvidence.priorExternalResult: For AC1021 source entity 0x452, ODA ACAD2007/2010 DXF recovered SAT payloads of 1071 bytes; the ACAD2010 payload was read by pinned ACadRust 0.6.8 with zero validation errors and its torus fields matched the source-derived SAT profile.
algorithmEvidence.implementationReference: LibreDWG 0.14 DXF output's SAT1 encryption and group-3 continuation handling, as detailed in the prior cross-check receipt.

focusedValidation.generatedInMemoryCarrier: PASS: exact-handle selection, group-1/group-3 joining, SAT1 inverse, escaped-caret reversal, terminator acceptance, malformed continuation refusal, and invalid-handle refusal.
focusedValidation.cliOutputSafety: PASS: generated scratch ASCII DXF decoded to the expected SAT bytes; a second invocation without --force refused to overwrite and preserved the output.
focusedValidation.fixturePolicy: All controls were generated in memory or under /private/tmp. No DWG, DXF, or SAT fixture was added to the repository.

limitations: This receipt does not re-run against the original ODA DXF files, which were not present in the current temporary directory.
The helper validates carrier framing only; it does not validate ACIS semantic records, geometry, graph association, native acceptance, or libdxfrw support.
It handles ASCII DXF and SAT v1 only; Binary DXF and SAB remain outside scope.
